# Antistasi Ultimate reference snapshot

Source repository: Antistasi-Ultimate-Community/A3-Antistasi-Ultimate
Source branch: unstable

This directory is a reference snapshot used while developing DU Commander. It is not compiled into DU_Commander.

Source files are copied for source-level integration analysis. See ../../../../docs/ANTISTASI_SOURCE_MAP.md for the reason each file is present.

The upstream project includes MIT-licensed components as documented in vendor/antistasi-ultimate/LICENSE.
